intent: Estimates the monthly cost of an infra change from an infracost plan and compares it to the budget — measure-and-warn, never a block — naming the drivers and recording the estimate.

dimensions.name: measure-and-warn
dimensions.criterion: Warns against the budget but never blocks — the measure-and-warn discipline.

dimensions.name: reads-infracost-budget
dimensions.criterion: Reads the infracost plan JSON and compares against tech_bindings.infra.cost_budget.

dimensions.name: records-artifact
dimensions.criterion: Records the cost estimate as the 02f artifact via the run harness.
